marketing_description: The NUVO LED Filament Bulb, series ST19, is a 8 W bulb with a warm white light appearance and a color temperature of 2700 K. This dimmable bulb has a medium base, is Energy Star Certified and Title 20 Compliant, and offers 800 lumens of light. It is designed to provide 15,000 hours of life and is a suitable replacement for a 40 W incandescent bulb.
